figs.name: mimic-panel-construction-layers-diagram
figs.alt: mimic panel construction layers with polycarbonate front, LEDs, backplate and desk mounting
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the four parts of a mimic panel: printed or engraved front surface, super bright LEDs, rigid backplate and screw mounting in a desk cutout.

figs.name: mimic-panel-fire-and-gas-response-flowchart
figs.alt: fire and gas mimic panel flowchart from hazard lamp to shutdown or manual extinguish
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a fire and gas mimic panel is used: hazard lamp, layout reading, pump status, then guarded shutdown or manual extinguish buttons.
figs.after_h2: Mimic Panel Role in Fire and Gas Safety Systems
